title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Assistance with household tasks Our services help participants keep their homes comfortable and clean by doing essential housework they’re unable to manage themselves. This includes providing linen services and arranging for the preparation and delivery of meals, ensuring participants live in a well-maintained environment. Your household plan includes Linen Service This service provides clean linen for participants who need help with their laundry tasks. It’s designed for those who cannot manage their laundry independently, ensuring they have access to fresh and clean bedding and linens regularly. Embrace collects dirty laundry or linen from the participant’s house, launders them at Embrace facilities, and returns the cleaned laundry to the participant’s house. This support is essential for maintaining hygiene and comfort for our participants. Preparation and Delivery of Meals This service helps with the costs of preparing and delivering meals to participants who can’t manage this themselves, if they don’t already receive similar support. It’s important to note that while the service covers preparation and delivery costs, the cost of the food itself is not included in the NDIS funding. Meals are prepared at Embrace Facilities and delivered to our client’s home. This ensures participants have access to ready-to-eat meals, enhancing their daily living quality.
